subject: Galvanised trailer supply for Lucca Trailers: 30-minute meeting?
body:
Hi Lucca Trailers team,

I read that Lucca has its trailer parts made in China and assembles them here in New Zealand. That's exactly how we supply dealers, so I thought it was worth a conversation.

I'm with Pinnacle Trailers. We're a steel fabrication company with our own factory in India, and we build galvanised and painted trailers that ship flat-packed to dealers in Australia, where our range is already selling strongly. We're now bringing it to New Zealand.

Here's why dealers are moving their imported range to us:
- Higher-grade, certified steel: we supply mill certificates and welder certifications so you can check it yourself
- Hot-dip galvanised or tough painted finishes
- ADR-approved drawbars and CTA-approved couplings for trailers up to 3500 kg, VINs supplied, and the build documentation your certifier needs for NZ entry certification
- Factory-direct pricing, landed below comparable Chinese imports
- Duty-free into New Zealand once the NZ–India free trade agreement comes into force
- Flexible credit terms: you can pay as the trailers sell
- Mixed containers: different trailers in one load, plus extra parts if you build or repair locally
- A trial container or sample unit, so you can test us without the risk
- Dependable lead times straight from our own factory, with no trader in the middle
- Our own proven designs, or custom features to make yours unique, depending on volume

I've attached a short range proposal built around the single and tandem galvanised trailers and transporters you already sell, with photos of recent builds from our factory.

Could we find 30 minutes in the next couple of weeks? I'm happy to meet by video call, or in person at East Tamaki on our next New Zealand trip and we can courier a weld cut-section and our mill certificates to you beforehand so you can see the build quality first-hand. Would a video call on Tuesday 1 or Thursday 3 December work, or is there a better time for you?

Kind regards,
